resources.string: Keeps the floating bubble alive. Silent and ongoing.
Tap the bubble to lock touches
Hold the bubble 1.5 s to unlock
Open Impel Down and grant "Display over other apps".
Enable device admin (or the accessibility lock) in Impel Down.
Optional. Used only to lock the screen with Android\'s lock action, and to keep the floating bubble visible while you use other apps. It never reads screen content.
Touches locked — hold the bubble to unlock
Impel Down %1$s · Android %2$s (API %3$d)\nNo network permission, no wakelocks, no analytics.
Idle opacity after 2 s (0 %% = invisible but still tappable): %1$d %%

If the bubble disappears after a while, the system (Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung…) killed it. Set Impel Down to “No restrictions” in the battery settings above. Also make sure the device admin or accessibility lock is enabled.
